infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Face Pass uses the front camera to capture your face on-device so it can issue an event-scoped pass. No face image is uploaded or stored.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Focaccia connects to services running on the organizer's Mac when Local network mode is selected.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: $(PRODUCT_NAME) needs camera access to capture your face on-device for event pass issuance.
